method: Deterministic subset of committed research CSVs. No new measurements; no missing-value imputation.

holuhraun-mobility.sampling_note: Regional sampling windows around catalog reference points; not a cave survey, traverse map or legal site boundary.
holuhraun-mobility.planet_dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)

metrics.label: Regional median slope
metrics.provenance: Derived from Copernicus DEM and LOLA/MOLA at the stated comparison scale.

metrics.label: Regional 90th-percentile slope
metrics.provenance: Derived; does not resolve wheel-scale hazards.

metrics.label: Median terrain ruggedness (TRI)
metrics.provenance: Derived; depends on DEM resolution and resampling.

metrics.label: Thermal scoring proxy
metrics.provenance: Earth: modeled annual air temperature. Planet: literature; different physical/temporal support. Not a direct temperature equivalence.

metrics.label: Fine sediment fraction
metrics.provenance: Earth: SoilGrids modeled surface texture; planetary literature proxy if available. Not a cave-floor measurement.
